sections.body_md: ENTP-A and ENTP-T share the same ENTP core. Within debate, experimentation and idea testing, the useful difference is how the two A/T styles handle confidence, pressure, feedback and self-correction, not which one is better.

content.quick_answer: ENTP-A and ENTP-T share the same ENTP core. Within debate, experimentation and idea testing, the useful difference is how the two A/T styles handle confidence, pressure, feedback and self-correction, not which one is better.

faq.answer: Around debate, experimentation and idea testing, the main difference is usually confidence style, stress response, feedback processing and self-correction, not a change in the ENTP core.
faq.question: What is the main ENTP-A vs ENTP-T difference?
faq.reason: Covers comparison intent and claim boundary.

faq.answer: No. A/T describes style differences, not a ranking. ENTP situations can reward steadiness, caution or revision in different ways.
faq.question: Is ENTP-A better than ENTP-T?
faq.reason: Covers comparison intent and claim boundary.

faq.answer: Look at your response to debate, experimentation and idea testing-related pressure, criticism, uncertainty and post-decision review rather than treating the label as a verdict.

faq.reason: Covers comparison intent and claim boundary.

faq.answer: No. It can support ENTP work-style reflection, but it should not replace skills, experience, values or context.
